about: Community load-order rules for mo2linttricks (MO2). 'load_after' = lower in MO2's list = wins. Every rule cites its source; inferred rules say so.

nexus:23219.name: LONGER LOCKDOWN - Act 1 Extended
nexus:23219.note: Author: Live A Little and Take a Breather are 'Tested/Compatible (Give my mod priority)'.

nexus:23852.name: HALTED HANAKO - Postpone NOCTURNE OP55N1
nexus:23852.note: Author: 'Should pair well with Live A Little. Just give my mod priority.'

nexus:13271:130530.name: Live A Little - OPLI compatibility add-on
nexus:13271:130530.note: Live A Little author: archive order should be 1. this compatibility file, 2. OPLI, 3. LiveALittle PL timers. Install it as its own MO2 mod so it can be ordered separately.

nexus:21623.name: OPLI - Overhauled Phantom Liberty Integration
nexus:21623.note: Live A Little author: OPLI's archive must have priority over Live A Little (q302 call phase).

nexus:23290.name: Take a Breather - Pace and Reputation Overhaul

incompatible_with.note: Longer Lockdown author: Take a Breather is not compatible with Immersive Gigs.

nexus:7831.name: Deceptious Quest Core
nexus:7831.note: Inferred: the framework's archive is named zDeceptiousQuestCore so that mods built on it (RippersXL, VendorsXL, Parking Spots Enhanced, Deceptious Bug Fixes) override its shared files.

nexus:30771.name: Gunsensical Reloaded
nexus:30771.note: Inferred from its files: .yaml/.tweak (TweakXL), .reds (redscript), .xl (ArchiveXL); the author says to install all requirements.
